notes: Three searches in Japanese and English found no award or bid-opening result pages for NovaSeq X 25B at any non-Osaka institution (Tokyo, Kyoto, Tohoku, RIKEN, NIG). Search engines do not index the result PDFs. The only hits were Osaka tender notices, which carry no prices. One is new: Osaka's JETRO notice of 24 Sep 2026 covers 78 items, including 25B 300-cycle kits (quantity 10) and 1.5B, 5B and 10B kits. Its award will come later, so it is an Osaka item and does not extend coverage to new institutions. I did not open any PDFs. I also did not try the kkj.go.jp portal or the per-university procurement pages directly.
how_to_mine: Query kkj.go.jp (the government procurement portal) and the JETRO national-university listings (jetro.go.jp/gov_procurement/national/) for 'NovaSeq' and '開札結果' / '落札者'. Then open each university's own 入札結果 page (Tokyo, Kyoto, Tohoku, Nagoya, Kyushu, Hokkaido, Tsukuba, RIKEN, NIG) and extract text from the PDFs with pypdf. Record the unit price per 25B 300-cycle kit, the bidder (Illumina KK or a distributor such as Funakoshi, Veritas or Toyobo), the quantity and the date. Compare the same SKU across 2025 and 2026. After the Osaka notice of 24 Sep 2026 closes, check for its award, which would be the first 2026 repeat buy at Osaka. Watch for 35B tenders from early 2027.
new_candidates: JETRO notice for Osaka University, 24 Sep 2026 (https://www.jetro.go.jp/gov_procurement/national/articles/403152/2026092400370001.html): 78 items, 25B 300-cycle kit x10. Check its award result when it is published.
kkj.go.jp keyword search 'NovaSeq' (government procurement portal) for award notices across universities
